reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Hawaii
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Is "posting and mail" a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic scenario identifiers
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

state(hawaii).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% We model a single eviction case and defendant for the scenario.
scenario_case(eviction_case_1).
scenario_defendant(defendant_1).

% The case is an eviction action.
eviction_action(eviction_case_1).

% "Secondary methods" may be used if primary method is unsuccessful.
primary_service_unsuccessful(defendant_1).

% Translate "primary unsuccessful" into the statutory threshold used in 666-8:
% defendant cannot be served with process within the State.
cannot_be_served_within_state(defendant_1).

% 666-8 requires "facts shall appear by affidavit or otherwise to the satisfaction of the court".
facts_shown_by_affidavit_or_otherwise(defendant_1).
court_satisfied_with_showing(defendant_1).

% 666-8 requires service to be "according to the special order of the court" in that situation.
special_order_of_court(eviction_case_1, defendant_1).

% Address is known (so the mailing requirement applies).
defendant_address_unknown(defendant_1) :- fail.

% For the "leave with agent/employee" component, 666-8 makes it conditional:
% it applies only "provided the agent or employee can be found".
agent_or_employee_of_mature_years_found(defendant_1) :- fail.

% Proposed method in the scenario: "posting and mail"
scenario_proposed_method(posting_and_mail).

% Helper predicate summarizing the scenario.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_case(Case),
    scenario_defendant(Def),
    eviction_action(Case),
    primary_service_unsuccessful(Def),
    cannot_be_served_within_state(Def),
    facts_shown_by_affidavit_or_otherwise(Def),
    court_satisfied_with_showing(Def),
    special_order_of_court(Case, Def),
    scenario_proposed_method(posting_and_mail).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation: HI Rev Stat  666-8 (2021)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  HI Rev Stat  666-8 (2021) (key parts modeled):

  If a defendant cannot be served with process within the State, and facts appear
  by affidavit or otherwise to the satisfaction of the court, then service may be
  made according to a special order of the court.

  Such order shall in any case include a direction:
   - to leave a certified copy with some agent/employee of mature years of the
     defendant, PROVIDED the agent/employee can be found; AND
   - to affix (post) a certified copy in a conspicuous place upon the premises.

  The order shall further require:
   - a certified copy be sent to defendant by certified or registered mail,
     postage prepaid, UNLESS the address is unknown and cannot be ascertained.
*/

% Threshold: substituted service by special order is legally available.
statute_hi_666_8_special_order_service_available(Case, Def) :-
    eviction_action(Case),
    cannot_be_served_within_state(Def),
    facts_shown_by_affidavit_or_otherwise(Def),
    court_satisfied_with_showing(Def),
    special_order_of_court(Case, Def).

% Required components under the special order (modeled as "steps").
% Leave-with-agent step is required only if an agent/employee can be found.
statute_hi_666_8_required_step(Case, Def, leave_with_agent_or_employee) :-
    statute_hi_666_8_special_order_service_available(Case, Def),
    agent_or_employee_of_mature_years_found(Def).

% Posting (affixing on premises) is required whenever the special order applies.
statute_hi_666_8_required_step(Case, Def, posting_on_premises) :-
    statute_hi_666_8_special_order_service_available(Case, Def).

% Mailing is required unless address is unknown/unascertainable.
statute_hi_666_8_required_step(Case, Def, certified_or_registered_mail) :-
    statute_hi_666_8_special_order_service_available(Case, Def),
    \+ defendant_address_unknown(Def).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Method modeling: "posting and mail"
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% What steps does the proposed method include?
method_includes_step(posting_and_mail, posting_on_premises).
method_includes_step(posting_and_mail, certified_or_registered_mail).

% Determine whether a method satisfies all required steps for special-order service.
method_satisfies_special_order_requirements(Method, Case, Def) :-
    statute_hi_666_8_special_order_service_available(Case, Def),
    % For every required step, the method must include it.
    \+ (
        statute_hi_666_8_required_step(Case, Def, Step),
        \+ method_includes_step(Method, Step)
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Secondary method reasoning (as defined in the question prompt)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Secondary methods of service are those usable when primary service is unsuccessful.
secondary_method_of_service(Method, Case, Def) :-
    primary_service_unsuccessful(Def),
    method_satisfies_special_order_requirements(Method, Case, Def).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_case(Case),
    scenario_defendant(Def),
    scenario_proposed_method(Method),
    secondary_method_of_service(Method, Case, Def),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Secondary methods of service are defined as those methods that may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful. Is posting and mail a permitted secondary method of service for an eviction action?
